act.name: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.description: Central law abolishing bonded labour, extinguishing bonded debt and providing enforcement and rehabilitation safeguards.

sections.title: Abolition of bonded labour system.
sections.text: Section 4 abolishes the bonded labour system; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Bonded labour is abolished and a bonded labourer is freed from the obligation to render bonded labour.
